_comment: OpenAI / Antigravity / any OpenAI-compatible tool definition. Register this as a tool in your AI assistant's function-calling config.

function.name: generate_tech_stack
function.description: Scan a project directory and generate a visual TECH_STACK.html page. The page includes: a stat row (total tools, categories, AI backends, data stores), a layered architecture diagram, a horizontal bar chart summary, and colour-coded tool cards per category. Detects languages, frameworks, databases, AI SDKs, testing tools, observability, security libraries, and infrastructure from dependency files.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory to scan. If omitted, uses the current working directory.

output_file.description: Full path for the output HTML file. Defaults to <project_dir>/TECH_STACK.html.

open_browser.description: Whether to open the generated HTML in the default browser after creation.
